headline: Naira extends appreciation to ~N1,380/$ ahead of CBN rate decision
peek: Naira firmed to N1,380.10/$ at the official window while the parallel market held at N1,425/$, steadying ahead of the July MPC.

headline: Nigeria inflation edges down to 15.91% in June 2026
peek: Headline inflation cooled to 15.91% on lower logistics and fuel costs, though food inflation quickened to 17.52% from 16.96% in May.

headline: CBN holds benchmark rate at 26.5% as Middle East tensions cloud outlook
peek: The MPC left the MPR at 26.5% at its 306th meeting, citing geopolitical risk and imported-inflation threat despite easing headline prints.

headline: External reserves rise to $51.92bn, easing FX pressure
peek: Reserves climbed to $51.92bn as of July 16 on CBN reforms, providing a buffer for currency stability and import cover.

headline: Creators debate 'the surprising rise of the naira' — what's driving it
peek: Nigerian finance channels dissect the naira's unexpected comeback and whether FX reforms make it durable — high-engagement explainer content.

headline: Quiet-luxury backlash: the 'anti-beige' movement gathers pace
peek: As every brand adopts the same muted palette, consumers push back toward faded fabrics, vintage and visible repairs over 'perfect beige'.

headline: High-end brands are removing logos in 2026
peek: Luxury branding shifts from loud recognition to subtle distinction, where restraint itself signals craftsmanship and cultural relevance.

headline: Creators call it: 'Why quiet luxury is DEAD and what's coming next'
peek: Fashion creators argue the aesthetic has saturated into a 'status trap', signalling where premium positioning moves after quiet luxury.

headline: 'Your quiet-luxury look is obsolete' — the 2026 status-trap critique
peek: A widely-shared take on how conspicuous restraint became its own uniform — useful signal on where discerning buyers head next.

headline: Show HN: I left Figma to build a diffusion-based UI design tool
peek: Founder thread on designing a full web app in a Figma-like canvas then handing off to an agent — active builder discussion on AI-native design.

headline: OpenPencil — AI-native, open-source Figma alternative
peek: Open-source, self-hostable design editor where AI works on real editable vector primitives — signal on the local/open design-tool shift.

headline: MOVD: training-free on-device text-to-video diffusion (WACV 2026)
peek: Runs diffusion video generation on smartphone-grade hardware with no retraining/compression — the frontier of truly on-device creative AI.

headline: NanoFLUX: distillation-driven FLUX compression for mobile devices
peek: First framework to comprehensively compress large text-to-image models for on-device deployment — practical local image-gen for designers.

headline: Figma AI in 2026: Agent, Make and Weave go multi-model
peek: Figma Make lets designers pick Claude, Gemini or GPT; Weave chains multiple generative models on a node-based canvas.

headline: Furniture & home-furnishings market hits $1.0tn in 2026
peek: The category stands at ~$1.0tn in 2026, projected to $1.43tn by 2031 (7.39% CAGR), with online growing at a 12% clip.

headline: High Point Market signals a turn from minimalism to warmth and craft
peek: Showrooms confirm a shift to earthy tones, curved silhouettes, burl veneer, inlay and traditional craftsmanship over cool minimal interiors.

headline: Furniture makers bet on modularity, customization and digital buying
peek: Across B2B and B2C the focus is modular, customizable, sustainable product plus immersive online configurators as e-commerce accelerates.

headline: Designers on YouTube: 2026 is 'the era of honest quality' in furniture
peek: Popular furniture-review channels emphasise craftsmanship and durable materials over trend-chasing — demand signal for premium makers.
